scope: Packaging and recovery safety; no mathematical review
inspection: Only three named frozen roots are scanned; exact nine-path exclusion allowlist; all other regular files and every directory are retained.
All frozen inputs, including exclusions, are hashed before and after recovery with permission and file-identity metadata.
One LZMA2 compressor, CRC64, 16MiB dictionary, fixed deterministic tar metadata, hard1GiB address-space limit; no second compression.
Recovery checks full archive identity and Git blob, base64 parts, complete XZ checksum and uncompressed tar hash before extracting allowlisted regular files.
Canonical relative paths only; no extractall, symlinks, devices, sparse files, duplicate members, overwrites or existing recovery destinations.
Every recovered file is rehashed from disk; modes and complete root inventories are checked.
All generated data stays in the publication directory; originals and existing archives are untouched.
No Git ref operations, network, Lean execution, repository scripts, source revisions or deletions.
inspection_correction: Before execution, adjusted failure logging so a rejected pre-existing recovery destination is not written into. No packaging or recovery attempt had run.
